g.text: • Connect Arduino 5V to breadboard positive rail (red line)
• Connect Arduino GND to breadboard negative rail (blue line)
• Connect one wire from metal plate to Arduino D12
• Connect another wire from metal plate to breadboard negative rail
• When LED touches metal plate, circuit completes and LED lights up
• Use 12x8 LED Matrix to display health status and sensor readings
• Qwiic connector allows easy connection of additional sensors
• WiFi connectivity enables wireless data transmission to web platform
• USB-C port provides modern connectivity and faster programming
• Double-check all connections before powering on
• Ensure proper polarity for LED (positive/negative legs)
• Use appropriate resistor (220Ω) for LED if needed
